# Pane captures

What `tmux capture-pane -p -J` printed for the real CLI's first screen, one
file per pane width. They are the shape the launcher has to recognise as "the
input box is showing", so the specs read them instead of a hand-drawn box.

Recorded from CLI 2.1.330 started with `--permission-mode acceptEdits` in a
pseudo-terminal, with no credentials and a temporary home directory, and
replayed through tmux 3.3a at each width. The working directory shown is the
probe's own (`~/work`). Trailing spaces are part of the capture.
